services.desc: Gull Lake Cruises offers unforgettable experiences on the North Star yacht on Gull Lake. Watch the sun dip below the horizonon an evening dinner cruise. Embrace the tranquility of morning on a brunch cruise with scrumptious cuisine or take in the lake with a lunch or dinner cruise. Explore the scenic beauty of Gull Lake on a captivating journey through the Northwoods. With a variety of themed and special event cruises, Gull Lake Cruises provides a memorable experience through Minnesota’s most beautiful destination.
